description: Two exact TinyDB 3.15.2 upstream documentation excerpts evaluated on pinned TinyDB 4.8.2, plus one healthy query control. These are version migration cases, not current upstream documentation bugs.
limitations: Selected historical migrations; not a random sample of open-source documentation failures.
Reference candidates and checks were authored together; reference replay validates the oracle and pipeline, not model quality.
These public upstream snippets may have appeared in model training; held-out means not used in local prompt tuning.
Configured checks and example share a Python process, so finite checks are not adversarial semantic-equivalence proof.

cases.title: purge default
cases.behavior: Clear all records from the default table of the TinyDB database. Keep the named archive table intact. The sandbox fixture starts with an archive table; the example creates and clears the default table.
cases.extraction: Concatenate only >>> command lines in the declared ranges; strip exactly the four-character REPL prefix. No command content is changed. REPL display output is not executable code.

setup.code:
import json
with open('db.json', 'w') as _fixture:
    json.dump({'archive': {'1': {'value': 'keep'}}}, _fixture)
setup.purpose: Create a separate named archive table to check default-table scope preservation.
setup.authorship: AI-assisted evaluator fixture, not upstream code
